program: Health-policy advocacy, community systems change, emergency resilience and prevention

nutshell.headline: PHAdvocates has proven policy capability, but current marginal health attribution and governance are unresolved.
nutshell.body: A $100,000 prior-weighted illustration is $78.8M donor and $93.8M illustrative gross resources per 10 QALYs. Central is $301M. A 5%-weight favorable case supplies 88.24% of modeled benefit.
nutshell.whyItMayWork: PHAdvocates helped win Medi-Cal coverage of the evidence-based Diabetes Prevention Program and reports more than a dozen state laws.
nutshell.whyWeAreCautious: Current programs disclose no incremental health denominator, policy counterfactual or next-gift plan; FY2024 audit flags going concern and an internal-control deficiency.
nutshell.recommendationBlocker: Obtain audit remediation, runway, current policy targets, partner attribution, next-$100K staffing, and linked uptake/outcomes.

programSection.boundary: All $7.533M expense is charged. Only a DPP-coverage policy-equivalent is quantified; other pathways receive zero QALYs.

model.headline: Weighted $78.8M donor / $93.8M gross per 10 QALYs.
model.body: Historical Medi-Cal DPP coverage is used as a mechanism benchmark, not a current outcome. Completer scale, attribution, QALY, gift and realization factors are priors.

equation.label: CENTRAL
equation.expression: 500 equivalent completers × 5% attribution × .05 QALY × ($100K/$7.533M) × 25% deployability × 80% realization

inputs.label: Annual DPP-coverage-equivalent completers
inputs.basis: Scenario only; no current PHAdvocates participant outcome.

inputs.label: Organization attribution
inputs.basis: Government, coalition, providers and advocates share causality.

inputs.label: Finite QALY per completer
inputs.basis: Trial anchors direction and persistence; values are not derived by combining the separate per-participant cost and review ICER.

inputs.label: Deployability × realization
inputs.basis: Restricted funding, going concern, internal control and unpriced use.

inputs.label: Gross-resource proxy
inputs.basis: Historical efficacy-trial proxy; price year/perspective not matched; not current Medi-Cal marginal cost or a lower bound.

model.uncertaintyBoundary: The favorable tail dominates; values are priors, not confidence intervals or observed outcomes. With zero gift deployability, QALYs are zero and cost/geography ratios are null.
model.fundingBoundary: Financial need appears acute; health-producing marginal RFMF is unverified, unpriced, and operationally risky.

evidence.result: 58% lower incidence at ~3 years; one-third lower at 10 years; ~4-year delay.
evidence.transfer: Medi-Cal implementation and current PHAdvocates contribution unmeasured.

evidence.result: FY24 $7.533M expense, $743K surplus, $2.010M net assets; going-concern and internal-control flags.
